draw.box().t1: The time of the first corner, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds such as `time` or `time[n]`.
draw.box().p1: The price of the first corner, on the scale of the pane the study draws in.
draw.box().t2: The time of the opposite corner, a timestamp like `t1`.
draw.box().p2: The price of the opposite corner.
draw.box().color: The border colour. Left as `none`, no border is drawn, so give a box a border or a fill for it to be seen.
draw.box().fillColor: The colour inside the box. Left as `none`, the box has no fill.
draw.box().opacity: How strongly the fill is drawn: the fill shows at `opacity` times the colour's own strength, and the default is faint enough to leave the candles readable.
draw.box().text: A caption drawn inside the box.
draw.box().tooltip: Detail shown while the pointer rests on the box, so the caption can stay short.

draw.delete().obj: The line, label, box or polyline to remove. `none`, or an object already deleted, does nothing; assign `none` to the name on the same lines so no later setter reaches the deleted object.

draw.label().t: The time the label is anchored at, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds such as `time` or `time[n]`.
draw.label().p: The price the label is placed at, on the scale of the pane the study draws in. There is no pixel offset, so pad the price with a multiple of `atr()` to clear the candle.
draw.label().text: The caption. Keep it short and put the detail in `tooltip`.
draw.label().color: The colour of the plate behind the text. Left as `none`, no plate is drawn and the text sits straight on the chart.
draw.label().textColor: The colour of the text. Pick one that reads on the plate, or on the chart when there is no plate.
draw.label().align: Which part of the plate sits on the anchor's time: `"center"` centres it, `"left"` puts its left edge there so it extends to the right, and `"right"` puts its right edge there so it extends to the left.
draw.label().tooltip: Detail shown while the pointer rests on the label.

draw.line().t1: The time of the first anchor, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds such as `time` or `time[n]`.
draw.line().p1: The price of the first anchor, on the scale of the pane the study draws in.
draw.line().t2: The time of the second anchor, a timestamp like `t1`.
draw.line().p2: The price of the second anchor.
draw.line().extendLeft: `true` continues the line past its first anchor to the left edge of the pane.
draw.line().extendRight: `true` continues the line past its second anchor to the right edge of the pane, which is how a line reaches into the space past the newest bar.

draw.polyline().times: The times of the points, timestamps in UTC milliseconds, paired by index with `prices`. The path is copied when the call runs, so changing the array afterwards redraws nothing.
draw.polyline().prices: The prices of the points, paired by index with `times`, so keep the two arrays the same length. A point whose time or price is `none` is a gap in the path.
draw.polyline().color: The colour of the path's stroke.
draw.polyline().closed: `true` joins the last point back to the first, making a closed shape.
draw.polyline().fillColor: The colour inside the shape. Left as `none`, the shape has no fill.
draw.polyline().opacity: How strongly the fill is drawn: the fill shows at `opacity` times the colour's own strength.

draw.setAt().label: The label to move.
draw.setAt().t: The new time of the label's anchor, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds.
draw.setAt().p: The new price of the label's anchor.

draw.setBounds().obj: The line or box to move.
draw.setBounds().t1: The new time of the first anchor, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds.
draw.setBounds().p1: The new price of the first anchor.
draw.setBounds().t2: The new time of the second anchor.
draw.setBounds().p2: The new price of the second anchor.

draw.setColor().obj: The line, label, box or polyline to recolour.
draw.setColor().color: The new colour: a line's colour, a box's border, a label's plate or a polyline's stroke.

draw.setExtend().left: `true` continues the line past its first anchor to the left edge of the pane; `false` stops it at the anchor.
draw.setExtend().right: `true` continues the line past its second anchor to the right edge of the pane; `false` stops it at the anchor.

draw.setFillColor().obj: The box or polyline to change.
draw.setFillColor().color: The new colour inside the shape. A box's `opacity`, set when it was created, still dims it.

draw.setFrom().obj: The line or box whose first anchor moves. The second anchor stays where it is.
draw.setFrom().t: The new time of the first anchor, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds.
draw.setFrom().p: The new price of the first anchor.

draw.setPoints().polyline: The polyline whose whole path is replaced.
draw.setPoints().times: The new times of the points, timestamps in UTC milliseconds, paired by index with `prices`.
draw.setPoints().prices: The new prices of the points, paired by index with `times`.

draw.setStyle().obj: The line to restyle. Only a line has a style.

draw.setText().obj: The label or box whose caption changes.

draw.setTextColor().obj: The label or box whose text is recoloured.

draw.setTo().obj: The line or box whose second anchor moves. The first anchor stays where it is.
draw.setTo().t: The new time of the second anchor, a timestamp in UTC milliseconds.
draw.setTo().p: The new price of the second anchor.

draw.setTooltip().obj: The label or box to change.
draw.setTooltip().text: The detail shown while the pointer rests on the object.

draw.setWidth().obj: The line, box or polyline to change.
draw.setWidth().width: The new thickness of the line, of the box's border or of the polyline's stroke.
